issues.description: Method signature mismatch for Stock.findStockIngredient: the problem statement UML (and the solution implementation) define a single-parameter method 'public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name)'. The template implementation instead declares 'public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name, boolean caseSensitive)'. This difference in parameter list will cause code examples and calls that pass a single String (e.g., findStockIngredient("Bacon") in Main and in SealSaloon examples) to fail to compile and confuses students about which API to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template API with the UML and solution by adding or restoring the single-parameter method: add 'public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name)' to the template. Implement it to delegate to the existing boolean variant (for example: return findStockIngredient(name, false);) or change the existing method to the single-parameter signature and handle case sensitivity internally. This preserves the educational intent while ensuring calls like findStockIngredient("Bacon") compile and match the problem description.
